stances_toward.note: Government alignment is firm: over EUR 300m of military assistance since 2022 (NATO Secretary General, Jan 2026), Zelensky's Order of Prince Yaroslav the Wise to Plenkovic (Aug 2025), and Croatia's M-84 tanks and M-80 vehicles delivered to Ukraine through Germany. No treaty, so partner not ally. Stable rather than warming because the president, Milanovic, wants humanitarian aid only: he refused to authorise officers for NATO's NSATU in 2024 and the Sabor failed to reach two-thirds for the EU training mission. Bond - affinity: Croatia reads Ukraine through its own 1991 war.

stances_toward.note: Skopje has aligned fully with the EU sanctions on Russia and given Ukraine humanitarian and military aid (tanks, helicopters, attack aircraft and ammunition; a Ukrainian agency puts the military aid at about 16% of the defence budget and New Eastern Europe ranks the country among the top four NATO contributors over three years). Partner and not ally: no treaty, and in February 2025 Skopje abstained on the EU-backed UNGA Ukraine resolution and backed the US text instead (Commission). Bond - affinity: solidarity of a small state with a larger one under attack.
